layman_headline: Fear grips the crypto market — sitting on the sidelines while waiting for a clearer setup.
layman_explanation: The overall crypto market is in a fearful state (28/100), Bitcoin has dropped 3.5% this week to $62,700, and most altcoins are bleeding even harder. There are a couple of interesting signals — TRUMP coin's RSI is deeply oversold at 26, which historically precedes short-term bounces — but the broader trend is bearish with high Bitcoin dominance squeezing altcoins. The Coldcard wallet hack ($114M+ in losses) and negative Coinbase premium streak are adding to the negative atmosphere. No setup is clean enough to justify risking capital right now.
layman_action: Stay patient and keep cash ready. The market is fearful but not panicking enough for a high-conviction contrarian buy. Watch for Bitcoin to stabilize above $62,000 and for the Fear & Greed index to either spike lower (creating a true capitulation opportunity) or start recovering. Don't chase anything yet.
expert_reasoning: RSI at 26.22 is the most actionable signal in this candidate pool, and RSI is our most reliable tracked indicator (71% win rate). However, several factors argue against entering now: (1) the chart bias is bearish at -0.70 with price below all major MAs and in a sustained downtrend; (2) BTC dominance at 56.2% is headwind for alts; (3) Fear & Greed at 28 with a worsening trend suggests the broader market hasn't found a floor; (4) the Coldcard hack and negative Coinbase premium are weighing on sentiment. Per my validated rules, when Fear & Greed is near 25 and the outlook is ambiguous, HOLD is the safer call. I'd need RSI to hold oversold while price forms a base near $1.40 support before entering.
